en.headline: Housing Bureau logs over 74,300 subdivided-unit registrations
en.dek: Winnie Ho told lawmakers the basic-housing scheme has drawn more than 74,300 applications about six months after it began.
body: The Housing Bureau has received more than 74,300 registration applications for subdivided flats under the basic-housing scheme, Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho said on Friday.

Speaking in the Legislative Council, Ho said the scheme had been running for a little over six months and that the response was satisfactory. She said six district service teams under the bureau would keep offering support to tenants who need it, including help to apply for traditional public rental housing or Light Public Housing, so that they would not be left without a home.

Ho said solving housing problems remained a priority of the current administration. Hong Kong's first five-year plan sets a target of basically resolving substandard subdivided units inside residential buildings by 2030, she said.

From 2026/27 to 2030/31, public housing production, including Light Public Housing, is expected to reach about 196,000 units, more than 80 per cent above the five-year figure when the current administration took office, she said. Of those, 70,000 public housing units are expected to come from the Northern Metropolis.

Ho said 1,070 Light Public Housing units still had to be completed for the government to meet its target of 30,000 units by the end of March 2027. She said the composite waiting time for public rental housing was expected to fall to 4.5 years in 2026/27 and to under four years in 2030/31 as overall supply rises.

zh.headline: 房屋局已收逾7.43萬個分間單位登記申請
zh.dek: 何永賢在立法會表示，簡樸房制度推行約半年多，已收到超過7.43萬個分間單位登記申請。
body: 房屋局局長何永賢周五表示，簡樸房制度推行至今約半年多，局方已收到超過74300個分間單位登記申請，她形容反應理想。
何永賢在立法會說，房屋局轄下六個區域服務隊會繼續為有需要的租戶提供支援，包括協助合資格租戶申請傳統公屋及簡約公屋，確保他們不會流離失所。
她表示，解決房屋問題一直是本屆政府施政重點。香港首個五年規劃提出，要在2030年內基本解決住宅內的劣質劏房問題。
何永賢說，2026/27年度至2030/31年度的五年，連同簡約公屋，整體公營房屋建屋量約19.6萬個單位，較本屆政府上任時的五年期多逾八成，當中7萬個公營房屋單位來自北部都會區。
她又說，尚有1070個簡約公屋單位需要落成，才可在2027年3月底前完成3萬個單位的目標。隨著公營房屋供應增加，公屋綜合輪候時間預計在2026/27年度降至4.5年，並在2030/31年度進一步降至4年以下。
